newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures plunge on investors' cash selling.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures plunge on investors' cash selling.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Friday's Tokyo session sharply down on investors' selling of cash JGBs, traders said.
The June closed down 0.66 at an intraday low of 125.45. Turnover was 51,087 contracts.
Investors sold a large amount of cash JGBs, particularly at the long end of the yield curve. This prompted bond dealers to liquidate long positions before the close, traders said.
There was no particular news which led to the afternoon JGB sell-off, apart from a sudden sharp fall in Euroyen futures, traders said.
